metadata.note: Aggregate evaluation: takes all three Working Backwards documents as one input set and scores cross-document coherence per AWS Leadership Principle. Not recordable in the spec-judge DB (per-file targets only — tool gap flagged). Rubric: evaluations/rubrics/awslp.rubric.yaml v0.1.0 (provisional; canonical home = specification-workflow-spec).

judge.note: Self-evaluation by the authoring agent session

categories.reasoning: Same customer (solo builder using coding agents, privacy-sensitive) at the center of all three documents; the 6-pager honestly stages obsession (ourselves first, friendly users gated) rather than faking breadth
Claims and plan are aligned with one exception found by this aggregation — exactly the class of defect per-document evals cannot see

findings.description: UNFUNDED PROMISE: press release ('watch CI health') and FAQ free-tier list both promise GitHub CI monitoring, and the free tier must exist at M3 — but no RMI in any phase built it. REMEDIATED in-session: RMI-VISIONSTUDIO-509 added to Phase 4.

Forecasting appears in press/FAQ paid-plan lists with no RMI anywhere; tolerable because paid tiers are post-M4 by definition, but label it 'post-M4 scope' in the PRD tier sketch so the promise carries its own timeline

categories.reasoning: The strongest cross-document thread: identical cost story in all three tellings — $0-incremental repurposed server (recouping an existing expense), $10 Lightsail alternative, subscription-first Mode A analysis, metered-before-automated, research-report offset. The cheapest credible path is chosen and the reasoning survives every retelling

categories.category: Think Big vs Bias for Action
categories.reasoning: Press ambition (multi-tenant platform, adoption analytics, public launch) connects to the 6-pager's start-now-on-reversible-parts plan with no missing middle: the M-ladder is the bridge, and Phase 1-2 is deliberately the reversible subset
Numbers agree wherever repeated (2-5 free projects, monthly cadence, >$100 MRR, ~$600 server, ~$10 Lightsail); depth gap is the known post-M1 baselines appendix, already committed in the 6-pager ask

Every externally visible claim traces to a milestone gate except the lp-001 CI-monitoring promise (remediated); milestones are outcome gates (sites serving unattended, tenants active weekly, MRR sustained), not activity lists

The document set carries its own quality loop: three versioned judge records on the 6-pager (3-fail to 4-pass with seams fixed), a re-judge-before-M3 commitment written into the ask, and this LP aggregation as a second lens

categories.category: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility
categories.reasoning: Proportional to stage: two-filter visibility rail at sync and serve, research consent with k-anonymity floor and unbundling path, deletion semantics (tenant = database), retention obligations named in the M5 gate review
